step.goal: Self-review — verify bug report completeness and quality

artifact-checklist.file: Bug reports folder — must contain one BUG-XXXX.md per failed test in junit.xml

quality-checklist.check: One bug report exists for every failed test in junit.xml — no failure goes undocumented
Each report contains all required fields: Bug ID, عنوان المشكلة, وصف المشكلة, خطوات إعادة المشكلة, النتيجة الحالية, النتيجة المتوقعة, مستوى الخطورة, الأولوية
Each report includes: screenshot/video/trace paths (if available), API error details (status code + URL), console errors from the test run

Severity is correctly classified using these heuristics: - 5xx response / login broken / payment broken → حرجة - Functional flow blocked with no workaround → عالية - UI defect with workaround → متوسطة - Cosmetic / minor wording → منخفضة NOT every bug is حرجة
Root cause analysis is specific — NOT generic ("unknown error", "test failed", "something went wrong")
Each report includes a suggested fix based on the root cause analysis
All bug report content is in {reporting_language}
Bug IDs are unique and sequential (BUG-0001, BUG-0002, …) — no duplicates

review.fix-if-needed: BG-1 → create a bug report for any undocumented failure by re-reading the junit.xml failure node BG-2 → add any missing required field to each report (re-read junit.xml for the specific error message) BG-3 → add attachment paths from the Playwright test-results/ folder; add console errors from junit.xml attributes BG-4 → re-evaluate severity: re-read the error type and impact; downgrade inflated "حرجة" ratings BG-5 → re-read the stack trace and error message; write a specific root cause (file path + line number + what went wrong) BG-6 → add a concrete suggested fix for each report BG-7 → translate all content to {reporting_language} BG-8 → renumber any duplicate or out-of-sequence bug IDs Save corrected reports before marking complete.
